title: Fact Check: Jennifer Aniston and Brad Pitt Did Not Secretly Remarry or Have Twins
claim_reviewed: Jennifer Aniston and Brad Pitt remarried in Paris and are expecting miracle twins.
fact_check_summary: Representatives for both Jennifer Aniston and Brad Pitt have repeatedly clarified that the former spouses have not reconciled romantically, never held a wedding ceremony in France, and are not expecting children together. Tabloid claims regarding nursery purchases at Chateau Miraval are fabricated fabrications originating from supermarket tabloids.

title: Official Record: Jennifer Aniston and Justin Theroux Announced Mutual Amicable Separation
claim_reviewed: Jennifer Aniston and Justin Theroux separated after two and a half years of marriage.
fact_check_summary: In February 2018, Jennifer Aniston and Justin Theroux released an authorized joint statement confirming their decision to separate at the end of 2017. The statement stated the decision was lovingly and mutually made, and both remain committed to continuing their close friendship.

title: Fact Check: Queen Elizabeth II Did Not Strip Prince Harry and Meghan of Royal Bloodlines
claim_reviewed: Queen Elizabeth II issued an emergency decree expelling Harry and Meghan from the royal family bloodline and confiscating passports.
fact_check_summary: Under British constitutional law and royal protocol, royal bloodlines cannot be stripped by decree. While Prince Harry and Meghan Markle agreed to step back from active frontline royal duties and surrender honorary military appointments, no passports were seized and Harry remains in the formal line of succession.

title: Official Record: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle Stepped Back as Senior Working Royals
claim_reviewed: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle decided to step back as senior working members of the royal family in 2020.
fact_check_summary: Buckingham Palace and the Sussex Royal office officially announced in January 2020 that Harry and Meghan would transition away from official royal duties and public funding to pursue financial independence in North America.

title: Fact Check: Lady Gaga Did Not Move In With Bradley Cooper Following His Breakup
claim_reviewed: Lady Gaga moved into Bradley Cooper's New York townhouse and they are planning an Italian wedding.
fact_check_summary: Lady Gaga directly refuted dating rumors on Jimmy Kimmel Live and Elle Magazine, emphasizing that their romantic chemistry was entirely acting for the film A Star Is Born. Multiple verified industry sources confirmed Gaga never moved into Cooper's home.

title: Official Record: Bradley Cooper and Irina Shayk Ended Their Four-Year Relationship
claim_reviewed: Bradley Cooper and Irina Shayk amicably ended their four-year relationship in 2019.
fact_check_summary: Representatives for actor Bradley Cooper and model Irina Shayk confirmed the couple amicably split in June 2019 and reached a joint agreement regarding shared custody of their daughter Lea.

title: Official Record: Lady Gaga Won Best Original Song for Shallow at 91st Academy Awards
claim_reviewed: Lady Gaga won the Oscar for Best Original Song for Shallow.
fact_check_summary: The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences officially awarded Lady Gaga, Mark Ronson, Anthony Rossomando, and Andrew Wyatt the Best Original Song Oscar for Shallow in February 2019.

title: Fact Check: Tom Cruise Is Not Retiring to a Secret Scientology Underground Bunker
claim_reviewed: Tom Cruise is quitting Hollywood to live permanently in a New Mexico bunker as supreme commander.
fact_check_summary: Tom Cruise has maintained an active feature film production schedule, continuing production on Mission: Impossible installments and Top Gun: Maverick. Representatives confirmed claims of bunker isolation are entirely fictional tabloid gossip.

title: Fact Check: FBI Did Not Raid Leonardo DiCaprio Mansion Over Underground Poker Ring
claim_reviewed: FBI agents raided Leonardo DiCaprio's mansion and arrested Hollywood stars running an illegal gambling ring.
fact_check_summary: The Federal Bureau of Investigation and Los Angeles Police Department have no record of any investigation, raid, or arrests involving Leonardo DiCaprio's residence. The fabricated claim was invented by clickbait rumor blogs.

title: Official Record: Leonardo DiCaprio Donated $5M to Amazon Rainforest Relief Fund
claim_reviewed: Leonardo DiCaprio pledged $5 million to help preserve the Amazon rainforest during wildfires.
fact_check_summary: The Earth Alliance environmental foundation co-founded by Leonardo DiCaprio created the Amazon Forest Fund with an initial $5 million financial commitment distributed to local conservation partners and indigenous communities.

title: Fact Check: Keanu Reeves Is Not an Immortal 500-Year-Old Vampire
claim_reviewed: Historical portraits and algorithms prove Keanu Reeves has lived without aging since 1530.
fact_check_summary: The claim originated as an internet meme pointing out coincidental physical resemblance to Paul Mounet and Charlemagne portraits. Reeves was born in Beirut, Lebanon in September 1964 and confirmed on the Tonight Show that the immortal conspiracy is a humorous internet joke.

title: Fact Check: Miley Cyrus Was Not Sentenced to Prison for Defacing Mount Rushmore
claim_reviewed: Miley Cyrus was arrested and sentenced to six months prison for spray painting Mount Rushmore.
fact_check_summary: The National Park Service and Pennington County authorities confirmed no vandalism of Mount Rushmore occurred and Miley Cyrus was never arrested or charged. The story originated from a notorious fake news satire site.

title: Official Record: Selena Gomez Received Kidney Transplant From Francia Raisa for Lupus
claim_reviewed: Selena Gomez underwent a kidney transplant donated by her friend Francia Raisa.
fact_check_summary: Selena Gomez publicly shared medical details and photographs in September 2017 confirming that actress Francia Raisa donated her kidney to Gomez following end-stage organ damage caused by systemic lupus erythematosus.

title: Official Record: Kim Kardashian Filed for Divorce From Kanye West in Los Angeles
claim_reviewed: Kim Kardashian filed for divorce from Kanye West after six years of marriage.
fact_check_summary: Los Angeles Superior Court records confirm Kim Kardashian filed for dissolution of marriage in February 2021, requesting joint legal custody of their children and citing irreconcilable differences.

title: Fact Check: Mark Zuckerberg Did Not Declare Kauai a Sovereign Kingdom of Meta
claim_reviewed: Mark Zuckerberg seceded from the United States after buying Hawaiian land to create his own kingdom.
fact_check_summary: While Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan own property on the island of Kauai, Hawaii, the land is fully subject to US federal and Hawaii state jurisdiction. Claims of sovereign secession or virtual monarchy are completely fabricated satire.

title: Fact Check: Will Smith Was Not Lifetime Banned by All Streaming Services and Theaters
claim_reviewed: Every major theater and streaming service signed an executive boycott banishing Will Smith for life.
fact_check_summary: While the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences banned Will Smith from attending Oscar events for 10 years following the 2022 Oscars incident, no streaming service or theater chain ever banned his film catalog or future projects.
